# xsingletary.com

> Xavier Singletary is a fractional GTM engineer who builds the systems that tell sales reps who to call, why now, and what to say, on the tools a company already pays for. He works with Series B and C sales and marketing teams.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://xsingletary.com/): what he builds, named proof, the three-step engagement, and the guarantee.
- [FAQ](https://xsingletary.com/faq): 27 direct answers on account scoring, lead scoring from closed-won data, replacing intent data, call analysis, ICP models, and what a GTM engineer actually does.
- [Diagnostic](https://xsingletary.com/diagnostic): scope a build.

## Core claims

- Analyzed 318 sales calls and found 90.8% of buyer pains raised in those calls went unprobed by reps.
- Built an account-to-outbound engine that enriched 11,000 accounts, with 93.9% of contacts verified.
- Built an account scoring model (Fit plus Signal) that scores every account against closed-won patterns, so reps know which account to work and why.
- Built an ICP model from 78 closed-won deals; the data contradicted the team's assumptions about which vertical was largest.
- Built the Apollo Pipeline Orchestrator, a routing system in daily use by account executives, not a demo.
- Built a Clay and HubSpot lead scoring model that scores every lead before a rep sees it.

## What he does

- Account scoring and prioritization, so reps know which account to work each morning and why.
- Lead scoring and routing built from closed-won data instead of a workshop guess.
- Call intelligence: extracting what buyers object to from Gong call transcripts and tying it to closed-won and closed-lost outcomes.
- ICP and buying-committee research, automated.
- Contact enrichment with verification.
- Replacing paid intent data with in-house signals.

## What he is not

- Not a replacement for RevOps. He's the engineering specialist RevOps brings in to build the systems on their roadmap, without asking them to stop running the stack day to day.
- Not a tool vendor or an agency. The systems run on the client's own stack and the client keeps everything.

## Engagement

A short paid diagnostic first, then a flat-fee build, then an optional monthly retainer. Pricing is set after the diagnostic, not before.
